exposure: mode of delivery (caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: caries increment between 3 and 7 years of age
cohort: All children born from 2000 to 2003 residing in Stockholm County, Sweden, at 3 years of age (n = 83,147), followed until 7 years of age (final cohort n = 65,259)
finding: Preschool children delivered by caesarean section did not have an increased risk of developing dental caries compared to those delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: Children delivered by caesarean section did not show an increased risk of developing dental caries compared to those delivered vaginally.
